## 1. Executive Summary & Value Proposition
AlgorOhm Robotics Inc. designs and manufactures vertically integrated embodied physical AI systems. Traditional industrial robotics suffers from a chasm between high-level Python AI foundation models and low-level C++ PLC motion loops, compounded by high-friction harmonic gearboxes that prevent compliant contact. AlgorOhm resolves both bottlenecks simultaneously:
1. **Algor™ Neural Stack (`AlgorOS 4.2`)**: Compiles multimodal Vision-Language-Action (VLA) transformers and 4.0 kHz Whole-Body Model Predictive Control (WB-MPC) into a single zero-copy memory graph executing on onboard FP8 TensorRT-RTOS silicon (up to 550 TOPS) with `< 1.2 μs` worst-case RTOS jitter.
2. **Ohm™ Hardware Core**: Custom Quasi-Direct Drive (QDD) Halbach magnet stators with `0.078 mΩ` phase resistance driven by `100 kHz` Silicon-Carbide (SiC) field-oriented control (FOC) inverters (`98.4%` peak efficiency, `142 Nm/kg` torque density, and `4.0 kHz` joint-torque sensing bandwidth).

## 3. Dual-Core Stack Modules

### 3.1 Algor™ Neural Stack (Software & Silicon Compiler)
- **ALG-01 — AlgorVLA™ Foundation Policy Engine (8.4 ms End-to-End)**: Multimodal transformer ingesting stereo RGB-D, 4D LiDAR point clouds, and 1,024-taxel tactile streams to output continuous joint-space impedance targets (`FP8 TensorRT-RTOS`, `Zero-Shot Manipulation`, `3D Gaussian Splat SLAM`).
- **ALG-02 — Whole-Body Model Predictive Control / WB-MPC (1.0 kHz Solver)**: Receding-horizon quadratic programming solver resolving centroidal momentum, friction-cone constraints, and self-collision avoidance across 42 DOFs (`Riccati Differential Solver`, `Centroidal Dynamics`, `Compliant Contact`).
- **ALG-03 — SwarmMesh™ Decentralized Consensus (< 3 ms Fleet Sync)**: Peer-to-peer spatial task allocation and conflict-based search (CBS) routing for up to 250 heterogeneous robots without a single point of server failure (`VDA 5050 Native`, `DDS / ROS 2 Iron`, `Time-Sensitive Networking`).
- **ALG-04 — DigitalTwinForge™ Physics Compiler (10,000x Real-Time)**: Differentiable multiphysics simulator modeling actuator winding temperature, harmonic gear hysteresis, and floor friction for overnight policy fine-tuning (`Differentiable Kinematics`, `Automated System ID`, `OTA Policy Rollback`).

### 3.2 Ohm™ Hardware Core (Electromechanical & Power Electronics)
- **OHM-01 — Quasi-Direct Drive (QDD) Halbach Stators (142 Nm/kg Density)**: Segmented compressed-coil copper windings with N54SH curved Halbach magnet arrays maximize air-gap magnetic flux while slashing Joule heating ($I^2R$ losses).
- **OHM-02 — 100 kHz Silicon-Carbide (SiC) FOC Drives (98.4% Efficiency)**: Integrated 48V–96V SiC MOSFET field-oriented controllers executing current-loop PID at 100 kHz for transparent backdrivability and virtual spring-damper behavior (`BiSS-C 24-Bit Dual Encoder`).
- **OHM-03 — Proprioceptive Strain-Wave & Cycloidal Gearing (< 0.5 arcmin Backlash)**: Custom titanium-nitride coated gearing with monolithic optical torque transducers built directly into the flexspline for true joint-level force control (`65G Shock Rated`, `18,000 Hr L10 Life`).
- **OHM-04 — Solid-State SiC Energy & Hot-Swap Architecture (6C Burst Discharge)**: High-silicon-anode cell modules with active cell-to-pack thermal management and arc-free blind-mate docking connectors (`UL 2580 Certified`, `22s Autonomous Swap`).

---

## 4. Verified Field Deployments & ROI Benchmarks
1. **Dresden Semiconductor Fab #4 (ISO Class 3 Cleanroom)**: `Kinetix-7 + Vortex-AMR 400` transferring 300mm FOUP wafer carriers with `< 0.04G` vibration floor and `99.994%` pick yield.
2. **AlgorOhm Zurich Electromechanical Lab**: `Ohm-QDD-140` stator torture bench sustaining `2,400W` continuous thermal load with `0.078 mΩ` phase resistance at `110°C` (`+41%` torque density).
3. **Stuttgart EV Chassis Plant**: `6x Kinetix-7 + 14x Vortex-AMR` coordinated via deterministic TSN (`140 ns` sync jitter), achieving `-34%` cycle time in a cage-free shared cell.
4. **AlgorOhm Boston Embodied AI Center**: `Ohm-X1 Bipedal Fleet` executing zero-shot sim-to-real transfer across 4,096 parallel Isaac/MuJoCo environments (`0.82 ms` policy latency).
